guards.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingest.claim_collection_job(worker text, lease_seconds integer)
 RETURNS SETOF ingest.collection_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF worker IS NULL OR btrim(worker)='' OR lease_seconds IS NULL OR lease_seconds<=0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='A queue claim requires its worker and positive lease duration';
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
      WITH candidate AS (
        SELECT source_id,endpoint,params FROM ingest.collection_jobs
        WHERE ((state='pending' AND available_at<=statement_timestamp())
          OR (state='running' AND lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp())) AND attempts<2147483647
        ORDER BY priority,available_at,source_id,endpoint,params LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
      ) UPDATE ingest.collection_jobs job
        SET state='running',attempts=job.attempts+1,lease_owner=worker,
            lease_expires_at=statement_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>lease_seconds)
        FROM candidate WHERE (job.source_id,job.endpoint,job.params)=(candidate.source_id,candidate.endpoint,candidate.params)
        RETURNING job.*;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingest.complete_collection_job(source_key bigint, endpoint_key text, params_key text, worker text, target_state text, claimed_attempt integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF target_state IS NULL OR target_state NOT IN ('pending','done','unavailable') OR claimed_attempt IS NULL OR claimed_attempt<=0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514', MESSAGE='A queue completion requires its target state and claimed attempt';
    END IF;
    UPDATE ingest.collection_jobs job SET state=target_state,lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL
      WHERE job.source_id=source_key AND job.endpoint=endpoint_key AND job.params=params_key
        AND job.state='running' AND job.lease_owner=worker AND job.attempts=claimed_attempt
        AND job.lease_expires_at>statement_timestamp();
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='55000', MESSAGE='Queue lease ownership, attempt or expiry no longer matches'; END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingest.pro_graph_commit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
IF EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE nodes AS (SELECT s.id AS id,s.upstream_source_id AS parent FROM "ingest"."sources" s WHERE TRUE),
      walk(root,node,path) AS (
        SELECT id,parent,ARRAY[id] FROM nodes WHERE parent IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT w.root,n.parent,w.path||n.id FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.id=w.node

queries.name: identity
queries.sql: WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT current_database() AS database,current_user AS actor,session_user AS session_actor,current_setting('server_version_num')::integer AS server_version,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation,current_setting('statement_timeout') AS statement_timeout,current_setting('lock_timeout') AS lock_timeout,current_setting('search_path') AS search_path,current_setting('TimeZone') AS timezone,pg_postmaster_start_time()::text AS started_at,(SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()) AS ssl,(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(datdba) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS database_owner),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

queries.sql:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,c.relkind,
   CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('r','p') THEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) ELSE 0 END AS bytes,
   CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,false) ELSE NULL END AS definition,
   c.reloptions AS options,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relacl::text AS acl,c.relrowsecurity AS row_security,obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class') AS comment,CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN ARRAY(SELECT ROW(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attgenerated,CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END)::text FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum) ELSE NULL END AS view_columns
   FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
   WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S') ORDER BY 1),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,a.attname AS name,
   format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,NOT a.attnotnull AS nullable,
   a.attidentity AS identity,a.attgenerated AS generated,a.attacl::text AS acl,CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END AS collation,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid,false) AS default_sql
   FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
   LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
   WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
   ORDER BY 1,a.attnum),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

queries.name: constraints
queries.sql:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,con.conname AS name,
   con.contype AS kind,con.convalidated AS validated,con.condeferrable AS deferrable,
   con.condeferred AS initially_deferred,con.connoinherit AS no_inherit,
   con.confmatchtype AS match_type,con.confupdtype AS on_update,con.confdeltype AS on_delete,
   pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,false) AS definition,
   CASE WHEN con.contype='c' THEN pg_get_expr(con.conbin,con.conrelid,false) ELSE NULL END AS expression,
   CASE WHEN con.contype='u' THEN ix.indnullsnotdistinct ELSE NULL END AS nulls_not_distinct,
   ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY u(k,o)
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=con.conrelid AND a.attnum=u.k ORDER BY u.o) AS columns,
   CASE WHEN con.confrelid<>0 THEN (SELECT ns.nspname||'.'||cl.relname FROM pg_class cl
     JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cl.relnamespace WHERE cl.oid=con.confrelid) END AS parent,
   ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY u(k,o)
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=con.confrelid AND a.attnum=u.k ORDER BY u.o) AS parent_columns
   FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
   LEFT JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid=con.conindid
   WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND con.contype IN ('p','f','u','c','n','t') ORDER BY 1,2),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,i.relname AS name,
   x.indisvalid AND x.indisready AND x.indislive AS valid,x.indisunique AS unique,
   x.indisprimary AS primary,x.indimmediate AS immediate,x.indnullsnotdistinct AS nulls_not_distinct,
   am.amname AS method,pg_get_indexdef(x.indexrelid) AS definition,
   pg_get_expr(x.indpred,x.indrelid,false) AS predicate
   FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid

   WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

queries.name: security
queries.sql:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil::text,rolbypassrls,rolconfig FROM pg_roles WHERE oid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('statarena_admin','statarena_ingest','statarena_runtime') UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) ORDER BY rolname) x) AS roles,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT p.rolname AS parent,c.rolname AS child,g.rolname AS grantor,m.admin_option,m.inherit_option,m.set_option FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles p ON p.oid=m.roleid JOIN pg_roles c ON c.oid=m.member JOIN pg_roles g ON g.oid=m.grantor WHERE m.roleid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('statarena_admin','statarena_ingest','statarena_runtime') UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) OR m.member IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('statarena_admin','statarena_ingest','statarena_runtime') UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) ORDER BY 1,2,3) x) AS memberships,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT nspname AS name,pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner,nspacl::text AS acl FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') ORDER BY 1) x) AS schemas,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT r.rolname AS owner,coalesce(n.nspname,'GLOBAL') AS schema,d.defaclobjtype::text AS kind,d.defaclacl::text AS acl FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=d.defaclrole LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE (d.defaclnamespace=0 OR n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) AND d.defaclrole IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('statarena_admin','statarena_ingest','statarena_runtime') UNION SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT c.relowner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')) ORDER BY 1,2,3) x) AS default_acl,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT r.role,'table' AS kind,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS name,has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'SELECT') AS readable,has_table_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_any_column_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES') AS writable FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('statarena_ingest'),('statarena_runtime'))r(role) WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m')
UNION ALL SELECT r.role,'function',p.oid::regprocedure::text,has_function_privilege(r.role,p.oid,'EXECUTE'),false FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('statarena_ingest'),('statarena_runtime'))r(role) WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics')
UNION ALL SELECT r.role,'sequence',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,false,has_sequence_privilege(r.role,c.oid,'USAGE,SELECT,UPDATE') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN (VALUES('statarena_ingest'),('statarena_runtime'))r(role) WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relkind='S'
UNION ALL SELECT r.role,'schema',n.nspname,has_schema_privilege(r.role,n.oid,'USAGE'),has_schema_privilege(r.role,n.oid,'CREATE') FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN (VALUES('statarena_ingest'),('statarena_runtime'))r(role) WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') ORDER BY 1,2,3) x) AS privileges),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured

queries.name: concurrency
queries.sql:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 'writer' AS kind,a.usename AS actor,ROW(a.application_name,a.state)::text AS detail FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND (xact_start IS NOT NULL OR state IS NULL) AND usename NOT IN ('statarena_runtime','rdsadmin')
UNION ALL SELECT 'advisory',a.usename,ROW(l.classid,l.objid,l.objsubid,l.granted)::text FROM pg_locks l LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid=l.pid WHERE l.locktype='advisory' AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND l.pid<>pg_backend_pid()
UNION ALL SELECT 'write_lock',a.usename,ROW(n.nspname,c.relname,l.mode,l.granted)::text FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=l.relation JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid=l.pid WHERE l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND l.pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND l.mode IN ('RowExclusiveLock','ShareRowExclusiveLock','ShareUpdateExclusiveLock','ExclusiveLock','AccessExclusiveLock') ORDER BY 1,2,3),encoded AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT row_to_json(raw)::text AS v,row_number() OVER() AS ordinal FROM raw),measured AS (SELECT count(*) AS n,coalesce(sum(octet_length(v)),0)+greatest(count(*)-1,0)+2 AS bytes FROM encoded) SELECT CASE WHEN n<=%s AND bytes<=%s THEN (SELECT '['||coalesce(string_agg(v,',' ORDER BY ordinal),'')||']' FROM encoded) END,n,bytes FROM measured
